invariants.name: authority-non-amplification
invariants.statement: Communication, repetition, endorsement, routing, aggregation, projection, republication, or transformation must not increase authority.

invariants.name: decision-basis-separation
invariants.statement: A changed trust decision must not by itself imply that authority changed.

invariants.name: explicit-resolution
invariants.statement: A material unresolved condition remains unresolved until an admissible material basis change is established.
